landing.heroTitle: International Association for the Defense of Flowers
landing.heroTagline: Where humanity blooms, nature is reborn.
landing.description: A literary saga and transmedia ecosystem that unites 195 national flowers and their pollinators through innovative formats: an illustrated book, an engaging card game, a comprehensive 3D floral archive, and interactive robotic exhibitions.
landing.bookTitle: Nahiara & the Guardians of the Flowers
landing.bookDesc: An illustrated literary journey through the world's most beautiful flowers
landing.gameDesc: Interactive gameplay celebrating global floral diversity
landing.archiveDesc: National flowers in high-quality glTF/STL formats
landing.exhibitionDesc: Museographic experiences bringing flowers to life
landing.visionText: Connecting cultures through the universal language of flowers, raising awareness about biodiversity, and fostering institutional and editorial collaborations worldwide.
landing.storyText: Nahiara & the Guardians of the Flowers is more than just a book—it's a gateway to a magical world where every national flower tells a story. Through this interactive digital experience, you can explore the 195 flowers that inspired the tale and discover the real-world connections between cultures, nature, and conservation.
landing.journeyText: The book is just the beginning. Explore the complete digital ecosystem of Nahiara's world.
landing.archiveDesc2: Explore all 195 national flowers in stunning 3D detail. Click on any flower to learn about its cultural significance, conservation status, and role in Nahiara's story.
landing.sagaDesc: Discover the full literary universe including the illustrated card game, robotic exhibitions, and educational resources that bring Nahiara's world to life.
landing.communityText: You're now part of a growing community of readers, educators, and conservationists who believe in the power of storytelling to connect cultures and protect biodiversity. Share your experience, connect with other flower guardians, and help us spread Nahiara's message around the world.
landing.shareText: Help us spread Nahiara's message! Share your thoughts about the book, tag us in your posts, and connect with other readers around the world.
